# dart-http

HTTP contracts, clients, servers, native runtimes, and protocol-neutral helpers
for Dart maintained by Hippolabs.

## Package map

- `packages/sse_helpers`: bounded, incremental Server-Sent Events wire model, encoder, and decoder.
- `packages/dart_http_core`: transport-neutral HTTP and routing contracts.
- Client WebSockets expose `sendBinaryLease`; portable transports safely fall
  back to byte sends while ownership-aware transports can consume native
  payloads directly.
- `packages/dart_http_resumable_upload`: resumable upload protocol, client,
  routes, and storage contracts.
- `packages/dart_http_server_runtime`: Rust-backed runtime with Native
  Exchange body ownership.

## Dependency direction

Packages remain independent of application frameworks such as Hippobase.
Generic native ownership belongs to Native Exchange; HTTP body semantics belong
here.

## Validation

Run `dart pub get` followed by `dart run melos run ci` from the repository root.
